question: What Scopes does the Atlas define, and what does each one govern? Name one key responsibility per Scope.
answer:
The Atlas defines six Scopes, each governing a specific domain of the Sky ecosystem:

*   **The Governance Scope**: Regulates governance processes to balance power and ensures the resilient equilibrium of Sky Governance is protected against threats. [The Governance Scope](/atlas/18ac7dd3-c646-4352-9b0d-d01a2932d7d1)
*   **The Support Scope**: Governs routine aspects of ecosystem support, including governance process infrastructure management and support for Agents and Ecosystem Actors. [The Support Scope](/atlas/1ce14bd8-c7b3-4f74-a152-292a8d8ebed0)
*   **The Stability Scope**: Governs the management of the USDS Stablecoin, focusing on its stability and risk management to serve as a public good. [The Stability Scope](/atlas/d56538fc-2220-491a-a4d2-7ad6e461d707)
*   **The Protocol Scope**: Regulates the maintenance and development of the core Sky Protocol and its critical, non-collateral components. [The Protocol Scope](/atlas/5c20d9af-0bb9-4ca1-a944-1e2cb6f8bb6b)
*   **The Accessibility Scope**: Governs accessibility distribution efforts and regulates user-facing frontends. [The Accessibility Scope](/atlas/99b1b47d-3c7a-4859-ac00-8c0849f9070e)
*   **The Agent Scope**: Regulates all Agents within the Sky Ecosystem and comprises all Agent Artifacts. [The Agent Scope](/atlas/4a08ca6c-e652-49e4-9b79-4831b20e600a)
